sources.snippet: This is the GGUF quantized version of Hermes 8B, for use with llama.cpp. For the Full HF BF16 Model, click here Hermes 3 is a generalist language model with many improvements over Hermes 2, including advanced agentic capabilities, much better roleplaying, reasoning, multi-turn conversation, long context coherence, and improvements across the board.
